1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kastam (Larangan Mengenai
Eksport) (Pindaan) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Mac 2018.

Pindaan Jadual Ketiga

2. Perintah Kastam (Larangan Mengenai Eksport) 2017 [P.U. (A) 102/2017] dipinda
dalam Bahagian I Jadual Ketiga—

(a) berhubung dengan subbutiran 6(1), dalam ruang (3), dengan menggantikan
subkepala "9114.90.00 00" dengan subkepala "9113.90.00 00";

(b) berhubung dengan butiran 9—

(i) berhubung dengan subbutiran (1), dalam ruang (5) , dengan
memasukkan selepas perenggan (iii) perenggan yang berikut:

"(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga K emajuan
Ikan Malaysia"; dan

(ii) berhubung dengan subbutiran (2), dalam ruang (5) , dengan
memasukkan selepas perenggan (iii) perenggan yang berikut:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(c) berhubung dengan butiran 10—

(i) berhubung dengan subbutiran (1), dalam ruang (5) , dengan
memasukkan selepas perenggan (iii) perenggan yang berikut:

 "(iv)  an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(ii) berhubung dengan subbutiran (2), dalam ruang (5) , dengan
memasukkan selepas perenggan (iii) perenggan yang berikut:

"(iv)  an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(iii) berhubung dengan subbutiran (3), dalam ruang (5) , dengan
memasukkan selepas perenggan (iii) perenggan yang berikut:

"(iv)  an e xport licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia"; dan

(iv) berhubung dengan subbutiran (4), dalam ruang (5) , dengan
memasukkan selepas perenggan (iii) perenggan yang berikut:

"(iv)  an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(d) berhubung dengan butiran 32, dengan memasukkan selepas
subbutiran (38) dalam ruang (2) dan butir-butir yang bersetentangan
dengannya dalam ruang (3) subbutiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

(e) berhubung dengan butiran 34, dala m ruang (5), dengan memasukkan
selepas perkataan "the Kimberley Process Certificate" perkataan "issued
by the Ministry of International Trade and Industry".

Dibuat 21 Februari 2018
[SULIT KE.HT (96)669/15-36 Klt. 18 Sk. 49(4); Perb.0.9060/18(SJ.22)JLD.2(SK.1);

DATO' SERI JOHARI BIN ABDUL GHANI

CUSTOMS ACT 1967

CUSTOMS (PROHIBITION OF EXPORTS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 31(1) of the
Customs Act 1967 [Act 235], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

Amendment of Third Schedule
2. The Customs (Prohibition of Exports) Order 2017 [ P.U. (A) 102/2017 ]
is amended in Part I of the Third Schedule—

(a) in relation to subitem 6 (1), in column (3) , by substituting for
subheading "9114.90.00 00" subheading "9113.90.00 00";

(b) in relation to item 9—

(i) in relation to subitem (1), in column (5), by inserting after
paragraph (iii) the following paragraph:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia"; and

(ii) in relation to subitem (2), in column (5), by inserting after
paragraph (iii) the following paragraph:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";
1.    ( 1)   Th is order may be cited as the Customs (Prohibition of Exports )
(Amendment) Order 2018.

(2)       This Order comes into operation on 1 March 2018.

(c) in relation to item 10—

(i) in relation to subitem (1), in column (5), by inserting after
paragraph (iii) the following paragraph:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kem ajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(ii) in relation to subitem (2), in column (5), by inserting after
paragraph (iii) the following paragraph:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(iii) in relation to subitem (3), in column (5), by inserting after
paragraph (iii) the following paragraph:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia"; and

(iv) in relation to subitem (4), in column (5), by inserting after
paragraph (iii) the following paragraph:

 "(iv) an export licence issued by the Lembaga Kemajuan
Ikan Malaysia";

(d) in relation to item  32, by inserting after sub item (38) in column (2) and
the particulars against it in column (3)  the following  subitem and
particulars:

(e) in relation to item 34, in column (5), by inserting after the word s
"the Kimberley Process Certificate" the words "issued by the M inistry of
International Trade and Industry".

Made 21 February 2018
[SULIT KE.HT (96)669/15-36 Klt. 18 Sk. 49/(4); Perb.0.9060/18(SJ.22)JLD.2(SK.1);
PN(PU2)338C/XXVIII]

DATO' SERI JOHARI BIN ABDUL GHANI
Second Minister of Finance
